data.name: Goswamee
data.gender_notes: Goswamee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A female devotee or wife of a god or a godly person. The name Goswamee carries the meaning “Goddess's Wife” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Goswamee usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess's wife and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Goswamee belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess's Wife.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Goswamee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
